map.仅保留指定字符是做什么的？: What does Keep-Only Character Filter do?
map.如何使用仅保留指定字符？: How do I use Keep-Only Character Filter?
map.仅保留指定字符适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Keep-Only Character Filter best for?
map.反向过滤：只留含目标词的行，删掉其余，聚焦关键内容。: Reverse filter: keep only lines containing the target word, drop the rest, focus on key content.
map.白名单抽取：从混合文本保留特定模式（如保留含订单号行）。: Whitelist extraction: keep specific patterns from mixed text (e.g. keep lines with order numbers).
map.降噪：在混乱日志里只留关心的信号。: Noise reduction: keep only the signals you care about in messy logs.
map.1000 行文本里设保留「支付」，输出仅 42 行支付相关；与「按条件过滤」的区: In 1000 lines, set keep "payment", output only 42 payment-related lines; unlike "conditional filter" it drops non-matching lines instead of merely hiding them.
map.和文本过滤有什么区别？: How is it different from text filtering?
map.文本过滤多为「显示/排除」，本工具是「仅保留匹配、丢弃其余」，输出即子集，适合直: Text filtering is mostly "show / exclude"; this tool "keeps matches only, drops the rest", output is the subset, ideal for producing a target list directly.
map.可设「任一匹配即保留」或「全部匹配才保留」，按是否需要 AND/OR 语义选择。: Set "keep if any matches" or "keep only if all match", choosing by whether you need AND / OR semantics.
